harbor_extra_docker_steps:
python3 -c "import hashlib, os, pathlib; spec = {"ETT-small/ETTh1.csv": [11520, "f18de3ad269cef59bb07b5438d79bb3042d3be49bdeecf01c1cd6d29695ee066", "0ac0ce309049e14728c529a0fa98e682edecf8650331c5b977e5a8dc3636b3b0"], "weather/weather.csv": [42157, "34ee981d07313e51da2a50bb600072c8ae4a69cb4b0651f4cb93a069d7a2ba63", "5761af96e2c79ebce25e12ad2e942cdcf85c28c7eeed6bc5c884e67308ec45af"], "electricity/electricity.csv": [21044, "7e45845d54c5219bad0ae6bc1b5316cf8ff9cead5d33fa998a5a51c2e4a497ad", "2c9f85931626ab87ceb30ea28174907e7a2252444aa214f5444d51b5d7e261aa"]}; exec('seen = set()
for rel, (k, full, vis) in spec.items():
 for root in ("/data", "/mlsb_data_root"):
  p = pathlib.Path(root) / rel
  if not p.is_file() or os.path.realpath(p) in seen:
   continue
  seen.add(os.path.realpath(p)); raw = p.read_bytes()
  if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == vis:
   print("already truncated (hard link of a processed copy):", p); continue
  assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == full, "unexpected source data: " + str(p)
  b = b"".join(raw.splitlines(keepends=True)[:k + 1])
  assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == vis, "unexpected visible prefix: " + str(p)
  p.write_bytes(b)
  (p.parent / ".mlsb_test_withheld").write_text("The test rows of the scored CSV in this directory are withheld from the workspace and mounted only for the final evaluation.")
  print("withheld test rows:", p, "keeps", k, "data rows")
assert all(os.path.realpath(pathlib.Path("/data") / r) in seen for r in spec), "a scored CSV is missing under /data"
')"

python3 -c "import os; names = {\"ETTh1.csv\": 11520, \"weather.csv\": 42157, \"electricity.csv\": 21044}; hits = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(\"/\") if not d.startswith((\"/proc\", \"/sys\", \"/dev\")) for f in fs if f in names]; bad = [h for h in hits if sum(1 for _ in open(h, \"rb\")) != names[os.path.basename(h)] + 1]; print(\"scored CSV copies:\", hits); assert hits and not bad, bad"
_harbor_extra_docker_steps_note: The scored test rows of ETTh1 / weather / electricity are withheld from the agent-visible image: these steps truncate every copy of each CSV (the base image's /data and the published-base data bake's /mlsb_data_root) to its train+validation rows (TSLib's own split borders; the first step asserts the source file and the kept prefix by sha256) and leave a .mlsb_test_withheld marker; the second step walks the whole filesystem and fails the build if any copy still has more rows. The withheld rows live in holdout/<task>/data/withheld/ (tests/meta/ in the bundle, mounted only at verification); scripts/_withheld.sh rebuilds each full CSV under $OUTPUT_DIR and checks it against the original sha256 before the eval runs, so scores are byte-for-byte the measured protocol. run.py (mid_edit) reports the validation split in the test split's place when the marker is present, i.e. in the agent's own runs.
